visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A person holds a large rectangular cream-colored box with light blue buckled straps against a background of a modern indoor room with a gray sofa and marble coffee tables. White text reading "Let's Unboxing" is overlaid on the frame. The background features a large arched window with a black grid. (2) Close-up shot of the box's top lid, which has a brown fabric texture and the gold-printed brand name "TAMBURINS PERFUME". White text "BLUE HINOKI PERFUME COLLECTION" appears at the top. The lighting is soft and even. (3) A young woman in a black off-shoulder dress sits on the floor and unboxes a large display case. Inside, a blue marble-patterned vinyl record is surrounded by various perfume bottles and miniature snow globes. The camera focuses on the intricate layout of the items on a beige velvet tray. (4) Detailed close-up shots show a blue woven ornament, followed by the woman holding a rectangular glass perfume bottle and spraying it onto her neck. She wears rings and a silver necklace, and her expression is calm and satisfied. (5) Final close-up shots highlight an egg-shaped beige perfume bottle with a silver turtle ornament on top, another round bottle, and a central blue vinyl record with the text "Blue Hinoki" on its label.
